item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NCRPRSD
item.description:

Mariano Alvarez, Carmona, Indang, Amadeo, Mendez, and Alfonso), Laguna (Calamba, Santa Cruz, Pagsanjan, Luisiana, Cabuyao, Santa Rosa, Binan, San Pedro, Lumban, Cavinti, Pangil, Paete, Kalayaan, Pakil, Mabitac, Santa Maria, Famy, and Siniloan), Pampanga (Floridablanca, Bacolor, San Fernando, Mexico, Magalang, Arayat, Santa Ana, Santo Tomas, Guagua, and Santa Rita), Quezon (Tagkawayan, Guinayangan, Calauag, General Nakar, Candelaria, Dolores, Tiaong, San Antonio, Sariaya, Lucban, Tayabas, Sampaloc, Mauban, Lucena, Pagbilao, Real, and Infanta), Rizal (Rodriguez, Tanay, Antipolo, San Mateo, Baras, Jala-Jala, and Pililla), Tarlac (Concepcion, La Paz, Tarlac City, Pura, Gerona, Victoria, Ramos, Paniqui, Moncada, Anao, and San Manuel), and Zambales (San Marcelino, San Narciso, San Felipe, Cabangan, Castillejos, Subic, San Antonio, and Olongapo) within the next 2-3 hours.

Keep monitoring for updates.
